method: All38 pages/300 sampled blocks/12000 displayed frames reviewed. Reproducible source-round-robin random sample of the2475 class-filtered candidate blocks. No visible edited overlay, unsupported player class or internal cut found. Ambiguous127 resolved against original frames in runs/expanded-audit-127-detail.png: ordinary machine-gun firing/movement. Native labels, damage flashes and opponent drones retained. Targeted pre-audits already excluded known bad blocks; this sample measures the resulting pool, not raw screening accuracy. Sampling and reduced image size can miss subtle defects. Duplicate and boundary review still required.
